title: fix(metadata-protocol)!: an unmanaged rename refuses a package without namespace whose object names all share a prefix other than the derived one
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X7DBJdArz6UfcraENi1dMpg)_

Fixes #35823

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: updated here — the refusal row in content/docs/deployment/install-modes.mdx; no skills/** file teaches the unmanaged rename (git grep targetNamespace under skills: 0 hits)

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:把未声明命名空间的软件包以副本方式装进新命名空间时,若它的对象名全都带着同一个别的前缀,安装会被拒绝并说清两个前缀,不再生成带双重前缀的副本。
- 为什么做:云端发布快照曾丢掉命名空间,副本里同一个应用出现三种拼法且无任何提示,属于数据静默出错。
- 出错会怎样:只影响带新命名空间的副本安装,拒绝发生在写入前,什么都不会装;声明了命名空间的包、只有一个对象或对象名没有共同前缀的包照旧安装。
- 要你做什么:这次改动让原来能装的一类请求改为拒绝(收紧),按规则需要你本人批准后才能合并。

## What changes

`planUnmanagedImport` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/package-unmanaged-install.ts`) derives the source namespace from the package id when the body declares no `namespace`. On the rename path (a `targetNamespace` different from that namespace) the rename engine trusted the guess: an object name without the derived prefix takes the target prefix in front of its whole name. A name that carries the producer's real prefix (`demoasset_asset`, under an id that derives `asset_lifecycle_b`) was copied as `trialdemoasset_demoasset_asset`, while its view `demoasset_asset_all` kept its name.

Now, on the rename path of a body that declares no `namespace`, the copy is judged by its object names' COMMON prefix (the card's signal; seat reading 7066371354 after L1 R1): when there are at least two objects, none carries the derived prefix, and every object name begins with the same first segment, the copy is refused through the existing rename refusal: `400 INVALID_REQUEST`, one `details.refused` entry per object, each reason naming the derived namespace, the common prefix and the missing `namespace` key, and asking to declare it (no namespace value is suggested). No new error code, no new `details` key; the refusal comes before the base exists, so nothing is written. Object names only (ADR-0129 D2 puts the namespace on object names): the gallery package this came from names its flows, datasets, reports and skills without the prefix, and translation items are named by the planner.

Unchanged, and pinned as controls:
- a body that declares `namespace` is renamed exactly as before, whatever its names look like (`namespace: 'other'` with `demoasset_*` objects still copies as `trialdemoasset_demoasset_*`; this control reds when the declared-namespace gate is removed);
- a multi-segment unprefixed name keeps ADR-0048 §3.5's amended rename: `purchase_order` copies as `trialdemoasset_purchase_order`, alone or beside `asset_owner` (no common first segment);
- a single-object package, bare one-segment names, and any package with an object carrying the derived prefix keep the rename;
- without a `targetNamespace` nothing changes: the save door's prefix rule already refuses these names (`422 NAMESPACE_PREFIX`, rolled back, nothing kept), measured on main 30b0987c.

The refusal row is added to the rename table in `content/docs/deployment/install-modes.mdx` (file surface widened by the seat for that one row).

Read first, by risk:
1. `package-unmanaged-install.ts`, `derivedNamespaceContradiction` and its one call before the rename loop: the rule that decides what is refused.
2. `package-unmanaged-install.test.ts`, the describe block `a namespace derived from the id, contradicted by the object names' common prefix`: the pins and the controls.
3. The changeset: the BREAKING sentence and the ADR-0087 disposition.

## Why

Data silently wrong: one copied app held three spellings of one package's names, with no refusal (card #35823, found on objectstack-ai/cloud#4856 whose publish snapshot dropped `manifest.namespace`; the cloud side is fixed there). Loud over lenient: a derived namespace the names contradict is refused, never renamed.

## Tests

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/package-unmanaged-install.test.ts`: 105/105 passed (8 cases in the new block).
- Ablations on the committed round (a7b30626), on-disk mutation by `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each trap-restored with `git diff HEAD` empty and the HEAD blob hash matched after:
  - the common-prefix refusal made a no-op (blob 0944eee5c9fa -> cb234f9d5ba6) => 2 failed / 103 passed: the refusal naming both, and the verb's zero-write refusal;
  - the declared-namespace gate forced open (blob 0944eee5c9fa -> d0bfa966ec7f) => 1 failed / 104 passed: the declared-`namespace` control (contract review S2).
- The tests import the module from `src/`, so no build is in the path.

## Acceptance notes

- The common prefix is the first `_` segment. Two objects sharing a short first word (`purchase_order`, `purchase_item`) in a namespace-less package are refused too, and declaring `namespace` clears it; the docs row says so.
- The no-`targetNamespace` path keeps its existing `422 NAMESPACE_PREFIX` answer (base created then rolled back) rather than a plan-time `400`; aligning the two would change an existing answer and is not this card's.
- filed #36166 — the silent cases the set-level signal leaves (contract review 7066464020, boundary flag ③): a single-object package with a foreign prefix, one stray object beside the prefixed ones, and a declared `namespace` the object names contradict still copy double-prefixed; plus the dated ADR-0048 §3.5 note for the `purchase_order` + `purchase_item` refusal.

## Verification

Two-minute check: run the test file above; the describe block `a namespace derived from the id, contradicted by the object names' common prefix — refused, never double-prefixed` passes, 8 cases.

Round 1 (head ca5b93e1, the per-name rule): CI all green or skipped, 95/95 derived gates exit 0, full dogfood battery green (PR comment 7066311396). This round's head is re-verified the same way and declared in a PR comment when the runs finish.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [ ] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (no formatter ran; `pnpm lint` is CI's run, read from its check-run)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
